shape_hint: A double-ended stud: both ends carry a metric thread (nut ends) joined by a plain shank turned down to a reduced (waisted) diameter d2 (about 0.7-0.8 d) so the stud is elastic; ends have chamfers and thread run-out (z2), and the stud is used with two hex nuts (DIN 2510-5).

role_map.d3: auxiliary diameter symbol d3 of DIN 2510-3 (not defined in the source text)
role_map.z2: symbol z2 of DIN 2510-3 (length at the stud end, not defined in the source text)

notes: Only Form L columns are published (b1). Sizes M12-M39 only. The meaning of d3, z2 and SW follows DIN 2510-3 symbols; the sources do not define them in text, so use the symbols with the DIN 2510-3 drawing when modelling. Thread pitch not tabulated here (use coarse ISO 261 pitch; Boltport z1 column equals the coarse pitch). Stud length L is customer specified.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched live fasten.it, boltport.com form-L, theo-schrauben.de (200); compared 9 rows (M12..M39) x 5 cols (d2,d3,b1,z2,SW) x 3 sources = 135 cells, 0 mismatches; also fasten.it vs Boltport for M42..M56 (identical). Checked d2/d ratio 0.71-0.78, monotone b1/SW/d3/z2.
problems: d3 and z2: header symbols only; no source (fasten.it, Boltport, theo) defines them; producer role_map admits 'not defined in the source text' and the Korean labels ('end auxiliary diameter', 'end length') are guesses -> dropped.
d2 (reduced shank dia) role is also not stated verbally; supported only by the standard's title ('reduced shank') and d2/d~0.75 - kept (flag).

SW: header 'width accross flats' (fasten.it), 'SW' (Boltport), 's' (theo); values jump 13->22 between M30 and M33 and M12 SW=7 < d2=8.5 (wrench flats of unknown location) - values agree across sources, meaning of the feature unknown.
b1 = 'Form L' mapping stated by Boltport page title / theo shop context ('Form L ... langes Gewinde'); fasten.it lists b1,b2,b3 without form names.

exactly 3 clusters for every cell; fasten.it and Boltport are identical on all 14 common rows incl. the omission of M22 and the '-' at M56 b1 (possible common ancestry, not provable) - if merged, support falls to 2.
theo has M22 (16.5,14,30,6,11) that fasten.it and Boltport lack -> M22 correctly absent.
